ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (estimated 85%) to low-intensity black pixels (estimated 15%) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white contiguous regions across both lobes. High-contrast dark banding located along the entire trailing edge. A distinct vertical dark pixel column extends from the median notch through the central axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp pixel-defined vertex and significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude oscillations (jagged serrations) along the superior boundary of both lobes, creating a non-linear trailing edge profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted from the median notch to the lateral tips, ending in slightly rounded, downward-tapering endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) scattered across the white ventral surface, with higher density surrounding the central notch area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial surface of both lobes, consistent with rake mark patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the trailing edge indicative of wear or trauma. Prominent dark vertical pigmentation streak at the fluke center.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, dark vertical mark bisecting the lower central region of the fluke.
